title: Medical Health Check Up Camp
summary: The 3rd Free Medical Health Check-Up Camp was successfully completed with incredible dedication from the entire team.
description:
The 3rd Free Medical Health Check-Up Camp was successfully completed with incredible dedication from the entire team. A total of 106 beneficiaries received comprehensive medical health check-ups, with their reports scheduled to be shared via WhatsApp. Alongside this, 104 beneficiaries received spectacles on the spot following free eye check-ups, and 102 Ayushman Cards were successfully prepared for community members.
The camp witnessed enthusiastic participation starting from 8:30 AM
Heartfelt gratitude goes to PE Rtn. Chetna Mehta for generously sponsoring breakfast and lunch worth ₹4,800 for the entire medical team and Rotarians, to Rtn. Sanjay Arora for sponsoring biscuit packets.
Project Chair Rtn. Hitesh Mehta and the entire project team seamlessly executed this impactful medical, eye check-up, and Ayushman Card registration drive. Together, the team once again demonstrated the true spirit of service and community care, proving that collective dedication creates a lasting impact.
location: Vidya Mandir School, Dahisar East, Mumbai, Maharashtra
